definitions.explanation: To become visible; to come into view.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}が{突然|とつぜん}{現|あらわ}れた。
{症状|しょうじょう}が{現|あらわ}れました。
{結果|けっか}が{数字|すうじ}に{現|あらわ}れている。
examples.english: The results are reflected in the numbers.

notes:
{現|あらわ}れる means to appear or emerge, used for people, symptoms, results, etc.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {現|あらわ}す (transitive, to reveal/show)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}が{現|あらわ}れる: a person appears
- {症状|しょうじょう}が{現|あらわ}れる: symptoms appear
- {結果|けっか}が{現|あらわ}れる: results show
- {効果|こうか}が{現|あらわ}れる: effects appear

ALTERNATE KANJI:
Sometimes written as {表|あらわ}れる (same meaning).

SIMILAR:
- {出|で}る: to come out
- {見|み}える: to be visible
